# Welcome to Journal

This journal is one file, and everything you write is saved into it as you type. The first line of an entry becomes its heading.

- Press ⌥⌘N for a new entry, / to search.
- Click the date above to move an entry to another day.
- Tag an entry by writing a word with a hash, like #ideas, then click the tag above the list to filter.
- Delete these sample entries whenever you like.
